title: Join the Innovation Club: Evaluate the Digital Accessibility of your Platforms
excerpt: Q-Leap will be taking part in Club Innovation, an event organized by the Chambre des Métiers, in collaboration with the Enterprise Europe Network and Luxinnovation. The event will be held on October 22, 2024 at the Chambre des Métiers, and will highlight a key topic: the practical implementation of the recently passed law on accessibility of products and services.
description: Alexis Leclercq joins Q-Leap, our team of testers, as Technical Test Consultant, expert in automation!
